FINAL ANSWER: The most enriched process in the ASXL1-mutated fibroblasts is nervous system development / neuron differentiation — i.e., the ASXL1-mutated fibroblasts show a strongly up-regulated neuronal/neurodevelopmental gene program relative to controls (preranked GSEA-style NES = 2.15, p < 1e-4, FDR < 1e-4; hypergeometric ORA odds ratio ≈ 46, p ≈ 3.8e-29; robust across all sensitivity checks).

EXECUTION PATH TAKEN: OFFLINE FALLBACK (as pre-agreed). Network was re-verified at execution time and is unavailable (DNS failure to pypi/Ensembl/GitHub), no R/Bioconductor, no GO annotation resources on disk, and the supplied HGNC file contains no GO terms. Formal GO ORA/GSEA was therefore not executable; instead I ran a quantitative offline enrichment against 11 curated, literature-established gene sets (MSigDB-hallmark-style: nervous system development, Wnt/PCP, ECM/collagen, interferon, cell cycle, NF-kB/cytokine, TGF-beta/BMP, apoptosis, OXPHOS, sterol/lipid, cornification), using both a preranked GSEA-style weighted permutation test (10,000 permutations, weights = |t|) and hypergeometric ORA — clearly labeled as a curated proxy for formal GO enrichment, not a formal GO test.

KEY RESULTS
(a) Data handling: 60,662 genes × 16 raw count columns (whitespace-delimited, versioned Ensembl IDs); 2 metadata-less samples (MGD1640F, MGD1641F) dropped; 14 samples aligned by name (7 disease/ASXL1-mutated vs 7 control). All 60,662 IDs mapped to gene_name via the supplied GENCODE v31 CSV (HGNC mapping not needed — GENCODE covers 100%).
(b) Filtering/universe: CPM ≥ 1 in ≥ 3 samples kept 14,912/60,662 genes — final gene universe for enrichment (universe size = 14,912).
(c) Normalization diagnostics: DESeq2-style median-of-ratios size factors from the 14,742 genes positive in all samples; range 0.840–1.428 (no outlier library); library sizes 31.9–56.3M.
(d) DE (log2-normalized-CPM OLS, condition + sex): only 3 genes at FDR<0.05, all up in ASXL1-mutated — VANGL2 (log2FC 2.47, t=9.4), XKR6 (1.05, 7.9), NEDD4L (1.37, 7.8) — consistent with limited power (n=7 vs 7). No-sex sensitivity: 5 genes at FDR<0.05, direction of all significant genes 100% concordant, corr(t_with_sex, t_no_sex)=0.975 → sex covariate does not drive the result.
(e) Preranked GSEA-style enrichment (full ranked list, directional, top = up in ASXL1-mutated):
   1. Nervous system development / neuron differentiation — ES 0.796, NES 2.15, p<1e-4, FDR<1e-4 (60 genes in universe)
   2. Epithelial/cornification — NES 1.51, FDR 0.077 (not robust)
   3. TGF-beta/BMP — NES 1.48, FDR 0.029
   (Wnt/PCP, ECM, interferon, cell cycle, NF-kB, apoptosis, OXPHOS, lipid all NES < 1.1 or lower)
(f) ORA (hypergeometric, BH across sets), top-250 up-ranked query: Nervous system development — 25/60 set genes in query, odds ratio 46.4, p=3.8e-29, FDR≈0; every other set p>0.1. Leading-edge overlapping genes: ROBO3, SEMA6B, SEMA4G, EFNB3, CNTN4, PTPRD, PTPN3, LRFN1, NEFH, GNAO1, CACNA1D, KCNIP1, KCNMB4, KCNT2, KCNS1, PIEZO2, PDE10A, KALRN, AMPH, APBA2, CYFIP2, GRID1, CLSTN2, BCL11A, EBF4 — a coherent axon-guidance/ion-channel/synaptic neuronal transcriptome program.
(g) GSEA vs ORA agreement: both methods rank the same process first with extreme significance — no disagreement to resolve.
(h) Sensitivity: enrichment of the nervous-system set is p<1e-4 with both with-sex and no-sex rankings (ES 0.796 vs 0.788), and ORA is significant at every query size tested (top-100 p=7.8e-40, top-200 p=1.2e-31, top-250 p=3.8e-29, top-500 p=2.5e-24).
(i) Complementary down-regulated signal (secondary): BMP/TGF-beta pathway targets are reduced (GREM2, ID1, PDGFC, CCN5 among the most negative t-statistics), but weaker than the up-regulated neuronal program.

CONCISE ANSWER TO THE QUESTION: The most enriched process in ASXL1-mutated fibroblasts is nervous system development / neuron differentiation: ASXL1 mutation is associated with ectopic up-regulation of a neuronal gene-expression program (axon guidance, synaptic/vesicular genes, neuronal ion channels) — top-ranked by both directional rank-based enrichment (NES 2.15, FDR<1e-4) and over-representation (OR ≈ 46, FDR ≈ 0). Caveat: with no GO annotations available offline this used curated gene sets rather than formal GO BP terms, and statistical power is modest (3 genes individually reach FDR<0.05), but the aggregate rank-based evidence is highly robust.
